name: Zayka
tagline: 18+ AI companions with long-term memory, face-consistent photos, voice notes, and realtime voice calls

pricing.notes: Crypto (NOWPayments) and Telegram Stars; annual ≈10x monthly with 2 months free; lifetime Gold tier exists. Free tier: daily messages plus daily bonus credits. 18+ only.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.limits: daily chat limits, photos, voice notes

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.limits: highest limits, realtime duplex voice calls, all perks

verdictSummary: A persona-prompt chat is one prompt away. What that prompt cannot reproduce: the same woman with the same face across hundreds of generated photos, a pinned-face photo pipeline with dual-verifier QC, pgvector long-term memory with per-user erasure, per-character voice cloning across 12 languages, realtime duplex voice calls, in-chat photo editing, and the moderation/CSAM/age stack underneath. The pipeline, the identity model and the safety layer are the product.
coreLoopDIY: Persona system prompt + an LLM API + a diffusion API for selfies + a TTS API, wrapped in a chat UI.
requirements: pinned-face identity pipeline (same face every photo, hundreds of poses)
pgvector long-term memory with user-scoped erasure
realtime duplex speech (STT+LLM+TTS streaming with barge-in)
moderation: CSAM scene gate, age verification, hash blocklists
Telegram bot surface next to the web app
whatYouLose: face consistency across the whole photo library
long-term memory she actually recalls weeks later
the same voice on notes and live calls
proactive messages that reference your history
in-chat photo editing ("change the dress to red")
content safety stack and 2257-style legal posture
whyPeopleStillPay: Consistency. Anyone can generate a pretty picture once; paying users want the SAME face, the SAME voice and a memory of last Tuesday — that is pipeline work, not prompt work.

priorArt.name: SillyTavern
